name: ChosenRoot
purpose: Uses a third-root witness for the impossible half-root; the positive suite proves no_half.

name: EmptySelector
purpose: Attempts unique normal forms without infinite support; the positive suite proves noninjectivity.

name: EraseCocycle
purpose: Attempts to erase the nontrivial cocycle with zero correction; cocycle_not_erasable is checked positively.

name: NoPositivity
purpose: Omits the positive-multiplier hypothesis; zero_multiplier_not_injective is checked positively.

name: CompositeCoordinate
purpose: Attempts to install a composite as a prime coordinate.

name: DenominatorUnit
purpose: Attempts to treat a denominator prime as a unit.

name: AutoImplicit
purpose: Checks that automatic implicit parameters are disabled.

name: ExtraAxiom
purpose: Rejects a new axiom even when unused by another theorem.

name: SorryAudit
purpose: Rejects sorryAx even when the warning is deliberately suppressed.

name: UnsafeAudit
purpose: Rejects an unsafe declaration in the audited namespace.

name: DropTorsionContainment
purpose: Drops the D-containment hypothesis from the pure-preimage classification. The positive suite proves the bottom subgroup is pure and is not any rational preimage.

name: CountabilityWithoutQuotient
purpose: Rejects an unconditional countability instance for an arbitrary rational subspace; the positive suite proves the exact countability equivalence.

name: DenseNotSurjective
purpose: Prevents replacing the dense inclusion by a surjection. Its failure is proved positively.

name: OriginalNotCompletion
purpose: The theorem compares the canonical completion to P, not the original subgroup to P.

name: ZeroRationalTail
purpose: The nonzero rational hypothesis cannot be dropped; the positive suite proves the zero exception set infinite.

name: ExactInsteadOfEventual
purpose: Rejects replacing an eventual signature with an all-prime statement. A numerator-prime counterexample is proved positively.

name: LiteralUnmarkedClassification
purpose: The conclusion is finite disagreement, not literal equality; a single-bit toggle gives the same group with a different selector.

name: FiniteChangePreservesMark
purpose: Finite changes admit an unmarked isomorphism but need not preserve the original indicator.

name: TorsionImageMeansZero
purpose: Torsion image is not zero image. A nonzero coordinate map between the same two groups is proved in the positive suite.

name: CompletionClassifiesSource
purpose: Rejects confusing an isomorphism of actual completions with an isomorphism of the original groups; the source nonisomorphism is proved positively.

name: OffDiagonalSeed
purpose: Rejects transfer between distinct prime coordinates. An actual zero-coordinate theorem is proved positively.

name: UnrestrictedDiagonalFamily
purpose: Rejects admission of the identity family between infinitely disagreeing selectors. Its nonadmissibility is proved positively.

name: QuotientScalarAutomorphism
purpose: A quotient scalar of one is not the coordinatewise nonzero condition. A noninjective selected-coordinate projection is proved positively.

name: InverseWithoutUnits
purpose: Rejects the reciprocal inverse law without nonzero coordinates. The zero multiplier has a checked nonzero-seed counterexample.

name: UnrestrictedCompletionReflection
purpose: The reflection theorem is not asserted for arbitrary pure preimages. The proper bottom-to-paired inclusion has a bijective completion map but is not surjective.

name: RationalLiftAdditive
purpose: A surjective quotient character does not make the chosen rational lifts additive. The half-plus-half counterexample is checked positively.

name: FiniteDirectSumSeeds
purpose: A finite seed family cannot generate D even under its full endomorphism ring.

name: FinitePairedTopologicalSeeds
purpose: Closure in the original induced topology cannot fill an omitted unselected coordinate.

name: CompletionGeneratorInSource
purpose: The new completion generator is not supplied by an original group element.

name: TopologicalMeansCyclic
purpose: Topological cyclicity does not imply algebraic cyclicity; a nonzero prime seed is a positive counterexample.

name: EmptySeedsGenerate
purpose: The nontrivial Hausdorff ambient group cannot have zero topological generators.

name: MarkedElementFiniteSupport
purpose: Finite off-selector support must not be substituted for finite total support.

name: PairedSeedRankOne
purpose: The exact least cardinal is aleph-zero, not one. A positive theorem proves inequality.

name: RootCountEqualsMultiplier
purpose: A nonempty fourth-root fiber has two elements, not four; the counterexample is positively checked.

name: RootSolvabilityOmitted
purpose: The radical count requires a root. The chosen marked half-root fiber is proved empty.

name: ZeroMultiplierFiniteFiber
purpose: Rejects deleting positivity. The same zero-multiplier fiber is positively proved infinite and nonempty.

name: RootNormalizationOmitted
purpose: Uniqueness of the normalized root is not uniqueness among all roots. A positive proof refutes this example.

name: WrongCyclicModulus
purpose: The quotient has the radical modulus two, not the original modulus four.

name: CyclicWithoutSquarefree
purpose: Cyclicity alone is insufficient. The positive suite proves that no quotient onto C4 exists.

name: InvalidRadicalTransition
purpose: The canonical residue transition requires the indicated divisibility; 6 does not divide 10.

name: ZeroCardMeansEmpty
purpose: Nat.card zero can mean an infinite type, not an empty type. This fiber is positively proved nonempty and infinite.

name: RootCodeFalseSuccess
purpose: Reject a mathematically false finite root-algorithm output, using actual executable code.

name: RootCodeWrongInverse
purpose: Reject a mathematically false finite root-algorithm output, using actual executable code.

name: RootCodeLostObstruction
purpose: Reject a mathematically false finite root-algorithm output, using actual executable code.
